api_contract.init_extra_setup_c:
g_eval_dev = device_get_binding(bus_name);
if (g_eval_dev == NULL) { return DRIVERGEN_EVAL_ERR_INVALID; }

test_stimuli.name: porta_all_high
test_stimuli.derivation: GPIOA=0xFF: each bit (bit0..bit7) is 1, so each channel = (0xFF >> n) & 1 = 1.

test_stimuli.name: portb_mixed
test_stimuli.derivation: GPIOB=0xAA=0b10101010: bit0=0, bit1=1, bit2=0, bit3=1, bit4=0, bit5=1, bit6=0, bit7=1.
